t: Lo and Behold, Reveries of the World
d: Oscar®-nominated documentarian Werner Herzog (Grizzly Man, Cave of Forgotten Dreams) chronicles the virtual world. He leads viewers on a journey that reveal the ways the online world has transformed how virtually everything in the real world works.
